title: Berida Zainab hai bhayya
body:
Berida zainab hai bhaiyya, majma e aghiyaar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Saath mere bas akela abid e beemar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Daakhila ahl e haram ka sham me jis dam huwa
Har qadam par sakhtiya thi, aur rone par jafa
Do qadam aise me chalna ab mera dushwaar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haath me patthar liye the sab tamashaayi khadhe Aur humko maarte the hum rasan basta khadhe
Kya kare zainab battao bekas o laachaar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Koobaku humko phirakar aur kehte the shaqi
Ye hai zainab dekhlo ye hai ali ki laadli
Koi kehdo naam na le ye bhara darbaar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Hind aati hai sar e zindaan zainab ne suna
Bibiyon mujhko chupaalo roke zainab ne kaha
Ek chaadar bhi humaare paas na darkaar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Qaidkhaane me sakina rote rote margayi
Mout meri bachchi ki zakhmon ko taaza kar gayi
Misl e zehra pasliya iski bhi to mismaar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Noke naiza se ye aati thi sada shabbier ki
Aye behan tu laaj rakhle maadar e dilgeer ki
Tu bacha apne ali ko wo bada ghamkhwaar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kya qayamat aagayi hai aal e ahmed par
Zameer
Uski parda daar qaidi jo zamaane ka ameer
Jiske parde ka muhaafiz khud alambardaar hai
<<MINI>>
Shaam ka bazaar hai aur sham ka darbaar hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam : Janaab Mohibbe Abid Abidi Sahab (Zameer)
